frontText: Navy 61 centered on a yellow door card. Dashed cut-line border. No other printed text.

items.title: Lake Baikal
items.placementTarget: Board, on the dark surround north of 40°N at the printed 100°E meridian.

cities.name: Lake Baikal
cities.graticule: On a small yellow island in the dark surround. The printed 100°E meridian passes through the disc. The printed 40°N line is well south of the island. No rat.

specialAreas.name: Lake Baikal island
specialAreas.notes: The only land on the sticker is the yellow island. A small blue patch on its southeast shore is the lake. The rest of the sticker is the dark impassable surround. No wall text, no lab icon, no route.

mechanics.notes: Red inland city, population 1, not infested, not a port. No printed route or recon.

summary: Lake Baikal. One red inland city at population 1 on a yellow island in the dark surround, sitting on the printed 100°E line north of 40°N. No infestation, lab, route, recon, or red region line.
